card.name: Warnings in cross-reference headings
card.fires_on: The word piece "arnings" completing "Warnings" in the cross-reference "[see Contraindications (4) and Warnings and Precautions (5.x)]" in drug labels.

modes.label: After Contraindications
modes.description: "arnings" follows "W" after "Contraindications (4) and" in a bracketed section reference.

modes.label: Warnings alone
modes.description: "arnings" follows "W" right after "see" in a bracketed reference with no Contraindications.
